documents.title: Weekly meal plan sharing
documents.content:
Weekly meal plan sharing

## Who
A household's cook, who plans the week on Sunday.

## Problem
The other adult cannot see the plan and asks every morning.

## Success
More people share plans.

## In scope
- invite by email
- the invitee sees and edits the plan
- share with up to five people

## Out of scope
- chat
- sharing beyond one other household member

## Dependencies
- the mail service (owner: Ben)

## Risks
- privacy
